caption:
Toto's knee is feeling better, but not quite trustworthy on the stairs yet.

That in-between stage is where clinical Pilates can be useful. Reformer footwork lets you build leg strength lying down, with springs setting the load. Knees share the job with the hips and ankles, so bridges and calf raises belong in the plan too.

Single-leg control comes next, slow and steady, so the knee is ready for stairs and getting out of the car. If you've had surgery, your surgeon's protocol and your physio's plan always come first. A knee that swells quickly, locks or turns hot and red is worth reviewing before you continue.

Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio works alongside our physios. Book online via the link in bio.
